chunks: Go to what you used to deny;
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran mean by 'Go to what you used to deny'?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse (Qaf 28) is often interpreted as a direct address to the disbelievers, commanding them to enter the Hellfire they previously dismissed as myth or exaggeration. It highlights the irony of their fate, where the very reality they mocked becomes their inescapable destiny, serving as a culmination of their worldly denial.
